standard_matching: identical face ids - for ALL tiles, including Flowers and Seasons
owner_rule: 2026-10-18: a tile matches only an identical tile (same picture and colour). The asset pack originally let any Flower match any Flower and any Season match any Season; that grouping is disabled here. The original file is kept unchanged in VeyaMahjong_AssetPack_v1/levels/.
free_tile_rule: No tile at (x,y,z+1), plus at least one of (x-1,y,z) and (x+1,y,z) is empty
tile_coordinate_system: positive integer grid x,y,z; layers overlap exactly
limitations: A solvable starting arrangement can become unsolvable after arbitrary moves; engine must provide undo/shuffle/rescue
